title: German Style Stir Fry with Herbs
description: A twist on traditional German cuisine, this dish combines the flavors of herbs and stir-frying techniques.

ingredients.name: Herbs
ingredients.notes: Chopped fresh parsley, dill, and chives

instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add onions and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add bell peppers and cook for another 3-4 minutes.
Add carrots and cook for 4-5 minutes.
Add potatoes and cook for 5-6 minutes.
Add bamboo shoots and herbs, stir-fry for 1-2 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with additional herbs if desired.
